# The first notice is quoted forever

Whatever the first internal incident notice says becomes the incident's story: early
cause speculation gets repeated in later summaries even after the timeline disproves
it. Keep the first notice to observed impact, current action, and next update time,
and let the cause appear only when the timeline can carry it. The notices written
this way never needed correcting; the speculative ones needed correcting in every
later document that quoted them.
